name: insyte
description: Read-only access to one or more Insyte Web tenants: jobs, job lines, contacts, companies, opportunities, invoices, payments and more.
long_description: Lets Claude query one or more Insyte Web tenants through the Insyte API (OData). It reads the API's metadata at startup, so every data set the tenant exposes is available with Insyte's own field descriptions. Read-only. Needs a READ API key from Settings > Integration > Api Integration (Professional edition, API licensed). Claude sees exactly what the key's Rep can see. To add more Insyte systems, run the add command from the insyte-mcp download; the extension picks them up from the OS credential store.

tools.name: insyte_list_systems
tools.description: List the Insyte systems set up for this user

tools.name: insyte_list_datasets
tools.description: List every data set the Insyte API exposes

tools.name: insyte_describe_dataset
tools.description: Fields, types and descriptions of one data set

tools.name: insyte_query
tools.description: Query a data set with OData filter, select, orderby, expand and paging

tools.name: insyte_get_related
tools.description: Follow a related list from one record, e.g. a job's lines

api_key.title: Insyte API key
api_key.description: READ key from Insyte: your name > Settings > Integration > Api Integration > New.

system_name.title: Name for this system
system_name.description: What you call this Insyte system when you ask Claude, e.g. acme. Letters, digits, - and _; anything else becomes -. Only matters once you add more than one.

api_base.title: API endpoint
api_base.description: Leave as auto to use the Insyte region that accepts your key. To set it by hand, paste the API Endpoint shown on the Api Integration page.

api_version.title: API version
api_version.description: auto (v3 when available), v2 or v3.
